raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Technical Program Manager
raw.excerpt: SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe.
raw.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

raw.excerpt: The RoleBJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia.
raw.description:
The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
raw.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Sales Operations & AI Manager

Full-time (40hrs a week), Hybrid Berlin, Germany / Wrocław, Poland Check out The Global Talent Co.'s talent network:

About Us: At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25k+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company: Join a fast-growing European brand-experience company shaping how businesses show up in physical space! Founded in 2014 with offices across Germany, Poland, and Sweden, the company designs and manufactures custom logo signage at scale, operating multiple consumer brands across the continent. Through people, processes, and technology, they're on a path to become the industry's first truly scalable player — and AI sits at the heart of that vision.

About the Job: As a Sales Operations & AI Manager, you will own the systems, automations, and infrastructure that power the sales engine. The role sits at the intersection of CRM architecture, AI-driven process automation, and lead generation — enabling the sales team to operate faster, smarter, and at scale. You'll partner closely with sales reps and content owners, turning a working sales motion into a fully systemised one.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end inbound sales process architecture — mapping, optimising, and systemising every stage from first touch to closed deal.

  • Configure, maintain, and continuously improve the CRM (Bitrix24) — pipelines, automations, fields, workflows, and integrations.

  • Build and deploy AI agents to automate repetitive sales tasks, enrich data, and accelerate decision-making.

  • Own the technical architecture of email marketing — sequences, segmentation logic, trigger rules, and tooling — in close collaboration with content owners.

  • Build and operate lead generation automations — prospecting workflows, data sourcing, enrichment pipelines, and outreach sequencing.

  • Ensure data quality and reporting integrity across all sales tooling, giving leadership clear visibility on pipeline health and funnel performance.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a growth engineering role — ideally in a digital-native or e-commerce environment.

  • Hands-on CRM configuration experience with proven ability to migrate and adapt platforms (Bitrix24 a plus).

  • Practical experience building AI-powered workflows or agents — not just using tools, but architecting solutions with them.

  • Highly systematic thinker — able to document processes, identify failure points, and close gaps without hand-holding.

  • Strong bias for automation over manual work — if something is done twice, it should be automated.

  • Tight prioritisation — few things, done properly, with measurable outcomes.

  • Fluent English (C1+); German or Polish a plus.

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.

raw.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

  • Own the roadmap and delivery for key product areas, keeping everything aligned with the bigger-picture strategy

  • Get hands-on with user experience: run research, explore the data, and talk to users to uncover what really matters

  • Turn insights into clear, prioritised product requirements and work closely with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Ops to prototype and iterate quickly

  • Prioritise work based on impact - balancing quick wins with long-term goals that benefit both users and the business

  • Define and track KPIs, and adjust post-launch to boost adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Lead go-to-market efforts: shape launch plans, support Customer Success, and ensure teams across the org are set up for success

  • Advocate for the customer throughout the product lifecycle, keeping things simple, intuitive, and user-friendly

  • Help shape tools and systems that support critical user journeys (onboarding, activation, retention), scaling operations with smart, high-performing solutions

Your Story

  • 5+ years of demonstrated product management experience, ideally within fast-growing tech, fintech, or SaaS businesses

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field

  • You see the endgame but are focused on refining every detail

  • A true builder: you thrive on crafting scalable solutions from the ground up and take pride in getting involved at every level

  • Hands-on operator with ultimate ownership - you’ll do whatever it takes to make your product successful

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity

  • Expert at distilling complex challenges into simple, elegant products that delight users

  • Data-driven mindset: you formulate hypotheses, design and run A/B tests, and make decisions grounded in evidence

  • Clear, empathetic communicator who can engage and align both technical and business stakeholders

  • Customer-obsessed: you weave user needs into every phase of the roadmap and prioritisation process

  • Excellent written communication skills

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

Social Media & Content Operations Assistant (AI-Driven)
Fully Remote - Full Time (40 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, execution-focused, and process-driven Social Media & Content Operations Assistant to support the growth of an AI-driven personal brand and deal flow system within the Dubai real estate market.

This is not a creative or strategic role. It is focused on execution, organization, and consistency within a structured AI system.

The working model is:

  • AI (Claude) = core system for scripts, workflows, and content planning

  • Founder = strategy and filming

  • Assistant = execution, operations, and daily management

You will be responsible for executing content, managing leads, handling outreach, and operating inside AI-driven workflows on a daily basis.



What We’re Looking For

This role requires a strong operator who thrives in structured systems and can execute consistently without constant supervision. The ideal candidate:

  • Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and process-driven

  • Is a strong executor who delivers consistently and reliably

  • Is comfortable working inside AI tools daily (especially Claude or similar)

  • Has solid written English for messaging, outreach, and lead handling

  • Can follow structured workflows and predefined content formats

  • Learns new tools quickly and adapts to systems with minimal friction

  • Is proactive but does not require constant direction

This is not a creative or strategy-first role. It is ideal for someone who enjoys systems, execution, and operations.



Key Responsibilities


1. Content Execution

  • Edit talking-head videos using prebuilt templates (primarily CapCut)

  • Add captions, overlays (e.g., price, location), and covers

  • Follow structured content formats and templates

  • Ensure consistency in output quality and formatting

  • Organize and manage content assets efficiently


2. Posting and Distribution

  • Upload and schedule content across platforms

  • Apply captions and formatting correctly

  • Execute content calendar generated by AI

  • Maintain consistency in posting frequency and structure


3. Lead Management

  • Respond to inbound messages and DMs across platforms

  • Qualify leads before passing them to the founder

  • Log and manage leads in CRM systems (Airtable or similar)

  • Maintain clean, structured records of all interactions


4. Agent Outreach & Deal Flow

  • Build and maintain a network of UAE real estate agents

  • Conduct daily outreach via WhatsApp, Instagram, and LinkedIn

  • Source off-market real estate deals

  • Track agents, deals, buyers/sellers, and follow-ups in a structured system

  • Ensure consistent follow-up and relationship management


5. WhatsApp Community Management

  • Support the creation and management of WhatsApp groups

  • Maintain engagement within the community

  • Follow up with members to drive conversations and deals

  • Ensure consistency and responsiveness

6. AI Workflow Execution (Core Responsibility)

  • Work daily inside AI tools (primarily Claude)

  • Use AI to generate scripts, captions, and content outputs

  • Execute tasks based on AI-generated workflows

  • Follow structured systems with precision

  • Continuously improve efficiency using AI tools



Required Qualifications

  • English B2 ! (MUST).

  • 2–5 years of experience in:

    • Social media execution (not strategy), OR

    • Virtual assistant / operations roles, OR

    • Community management / lead handling

  • Strong written English (clear, professional, error-free communication)

  • Experience using tools such as:

    • CapCut (or similar video editing tools)

    • Canva (basic level)

    • Google Workspace

    • CRM tools (Airtable, Notion, etc.)

    • Messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn)

  • Comfortable working in structured environments with predefined systems

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision



Ideal Profile

  • You are an execution-first operator, not a strategist

  • You enjoy working within systems and structured workflows

  • You are comfortable using AI tools daily and eager to learn

  • You are reliable, consistent, and highly organized

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in written English

  • You are proactive but do not need constant guidance

  • You are focused on results through disciplined execution



What We Are NOT Looking For

  • Pure designers or video editors

  • High-level strategists or content planners

  • Creative-first profiles

  • Candidates resistant to AI tools

  • Individuals who require constant direction or hand-holding

raw.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.excerpt: Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden.
raw.description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Als Digital Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude.

Du baust eigenständig eine starke Sales-Pipeline und ein belastbares Netzwerk auf – denn nachhaltiger Vertrieb beginnt mit deiner eigenen Initiative. Mit deinem Gespür für die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden identifizierst du die richtigen Chancen, positionierst unser Cybersecurity-Angebot überzeugend und präsentierst Lösungen, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können. So erreichst und übertriffst du deine Vertriebsziele.

Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neues Geschäft voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle.

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei:

  • Identifikation und Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im SMB-Segment am DACH Markt

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Vertriebszyklus – von der Erstansprache bis zum Abschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Sales-Quote zu erfüllen

  • Aufbau, Qualifizierung und eigenständige Entwicklung neuer Leads zur Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen und gut gefüllten Sales-Pipeline.

  • Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen in enger Kooperation mit Customer Success Managern

  • Aufbau nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller Kunden und überzeugende Präsentation des Mehrwerts unserer Cybersecurity-Lösungen

  • Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts in Online-Demos, persönlichen Meetings und auf Veranstaltungen zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts

Was dich auszeichnet:

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr full cycle Sales Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertriebsumfeld in DACH mit mit Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung – idealerweise im SMB-Vertrieb in einem agilen, schnelllebigen Umfeld

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst Initiative, bleibst konsequent zielorientiert und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Nachhaltigkeit zum Abschluss

  • Teamfähigkeit und cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit – du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Customer Success und Produktteams zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse bestmöglich zu adressieren

  • Proaktivität und Eigenverantwortung – du organisierst deine Pipeline selbstständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und handelst lösungsorientiert

  • Anpassungsfähigkeit und Gespür für Prioritäten – du findest dich schnell in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld zurecht und bleibst auch unter Druck fokussiert

  • Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für Feedback – du nutzt Coaching aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung deiner Vertriebsskills und hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-gestützten Vertriebs- und Produktivitätstools – du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbare Lösungen zur Gesprächsvorbereitung, Angebotserstellung und Recherche; du bist vertraut mit KI-gestützten Sales-Tools zur Optimierung deiner Outreach- und Closing-Aktivitäten

  • Erfahrung mit CRM- und Prospecting-Tools – du hast erste Kenntnisse in Salesforce oder HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator sowie gängigen Sequencing-Tools

  • Bereitschaft zum hybriden Arbeiten – mit regelmäßigen Präsenztagen im Kölner Büro

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Über uns

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

raw.excerpt: Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back.
raw.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!


What We're Looking For

We are seeking a driven, coachable, and competitive Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. Our BDRs are the engine of our outbound growth and this is a hands-on prospecting role focused on creating pipelines from scratch.

You will identify and create new business opportunities through high-volume outbound outreach, develop strong discovery and messaging skills, and help us build a repeatable outbound playbook as we scale. This role is ideal for someone who wants to master outbound sales and grow into a future AE or revenue leadership path.

Candidates must be located in the GTA, as this is a hybrid position requiring candidates to come into the Downtown Toronto office 3-4 days a week (Mon - Wed+).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Outbound Pipeline Creation: Own prospecting into targeted accounts through cold calling (80 - 100/day), email, and social outreach. Research accounts, personalize messaging, and consistently generate qualified meetings that convert into pipeline.

  • Structured Execution: Operate with discipline and consistency against daily activity targets. Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, track performance metrics, and continuously test and refine outreach strategies.

  • Product & Industry Fluency: Develop a strong understanding of Alternative Payments’ platform and the Managed Service Provider (MSP) ecosystem. Stay curious about fintech trends and emerging tools (including AI!) that improve outbound effectiveness.

  • Sales Strategy Collaboration: Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership to refine messaging, share market feedback, and contribute to scalable outbound strategies.

  • Team Contribution: Participate actively in coaching, training, and peer collaboration to continuously elevate individual and team performance.

What you will Bring (Required)

Core Attributes

  • High internal drive and competitiveness, with comfort handling rejection and high outbound volume

  • Strong coachability and willingness to implement feedback quickly

  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills

  • Organized, systems-oriented approach to managing work and data


Experience: We are open to two profiles

Option A: Early Sales Experience (1–2 years)

  • Experience in outbound sales, SDR/BDR, or related roles

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding activity or meeting targets

  • Experience maintaining accurate CRM records

Nice to have:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or the MSP ecosystem

  • Startup or high-growth company experience

  • Familiarity with modern sales tools or AI-assisted prospecting workflows

Option B: High-Drive Career Starter

  • Experience in high-performance or customer-facing environments (e.g., athletics, hospitality, recruitment, or similar)

  • Demonstrated grit, consistency, and goal achievement

  • Strong interest in building a long-term career in sales and fintech

We value mindset, work ethic, and growth potential as much as prior experience.

Compensation

Total compensation range for this role is $80k CAD

($60k base + $20K uncapped bonus). The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

What We Offer

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

  • Real growth potential: With our BDR team being our primary funnel for more senior sales/sales adjacent roles, your performance will directly influence your growth trajectory within our team.

Check out this video to see what growth at Alternative Payments is all about!

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

  6. Comfort working independently in a fully remote, digital-first environment.
  7. Attention to detail and commitment to scientific accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Prior experience developing or applying rubrics in scientific or educational contexts.
  2. Experience with AI, machine learning, or annotation projects related to biology or microbiology.
  3. Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in a relevant field.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

About the AI Receptionist Team

At MEDvidi, we're building AI-powered products that improve both the patient experience and the operational efficiency of healthcare delivery.

One of our key AI initiatives is AI Receptionist - a conversational AI product that serves as the first point of contact for patients across chat and voice channels.

Today, AI Receptionist helps patients schedule and reschedule appointments, answer billing and payment questions, provide prescription-related information, and navigate their care journey. Rather than relying on scripted responses, it works with real backend systems - including appointments, payments, prescriptions, and patient records - to deliver accurate, context-aware assistance.

As the product evolves, we're expanding into more advanced AI capabilities, including provider visit preparation, intelligent patient guidance, and increasingly autonomous support experiences.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own one of our strategic AI product areas end-to-end.

You'll lead a small, cross-functional product team and be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, execution, and business outcomes of your domain. Working closely with Engineering, Clinical, and Operations teams, you'll shape how conversational AI is integrated into real healthcare workflows while continuously improving the patient experience.

This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership. You'll be responsible not only for deciding what to build next, but also for understanding how AI behaves in production, validating hypotheses, measuring impact, and continuously improving the product based on real user data.

Why this role

  • Own one of MEDvidi's strategic AI product areas with clear business impact.
  • Build production AI agents used by thousands of real patients every day.
  • Work on meaningful AI applications where quality, safety, and reliability genuinely matter.
  • Collaborate with experienced Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Join a modern AI organization where experimentation, ownership, and data drive product decisions.
  • Grow alongside one of the company's fastest-scaling AI product areas.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for your AI product area across multiple communication channels.
  • Translate patient and business needs into clear product priorities and deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Continuously improve AI product quality through experimentation, evaluation, and iterative product development.
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to shape not only what AI should do, but how it behaves in production.
  • Define product success metrics, monitor performance, and connect product improvements to measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive product discovery through hypothesis validation, data analysis, and user feedback.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Ensure patient safety, privacy, and quality remain central to product decisions in a regulated healthcare environment.
  • Clearly communicate priorities, trade-offs, progress, and risks across stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in Product Management with genuine end-to-end ownership, including 2+ years as an AI PM shipping AI/ML-based products in production.
  • Strong understanding of how modern AI products work, including prompting, evaluation, iteration, failure modes, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Experience working in an experimentation-driven product environment: forming hypotheses, running experiments, measuring outcomes, and making product decisions based on evidence.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience defining product KPIs, working with data, and connecting product performance to business outcomes.
  • Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to make evidence-based decisions under ambiguity.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering teams and being comfortable discussing technical implementation details.
  • Excellent prioritization, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • A strong ownership mindset - you proactively drive initiatives, challenge assumptions, and take responsibility for outcomes.
  • Professional proficiency in both Russian and English, including experience communicating with native speakers.
  • Ability to work CET/CEST overlapping hours.
  • Comfortable working under a long-term B2B contractor model using personal equipment.

Would be a plus

  • Experience working in healthcare, telehealth, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience building products focused on operational automation, customer support, or workflow optimization.

What we offer

  • Meaningful impact: Build AI products that directly improve healthcare experiences for thousands of patients.
  • High ownership: Own a strategic product area with autonomy, fast decision-making, and direct influence on product direction.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear opportunities for professional growth.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 22 working days of vacation per year, 5 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Position Overview & Schedule

The more business the company produces the more personal income will grow. (you have a stake in the success of the business)

  • 2027 income goal based on $22,000/month in business will exceed $40,000 annually with uncapped incentives.

  • Features a no-cap incentive program based on company’s production.

  • Long Term Growth & Stock Plan: Earn a true 5% stake in the company via a Senior Manager/Director Phantom Stock Plan that starts to vests after year 3,

  • At a running rate of $25,000 per month company sales production, the role converts to W2 (USA) or W8-BEN (international) at a $36,000/year base salary plus incentive bonuses.

Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

  • Marketing & Design: Create ad artwork using Illustrator and manage website maintenance/upgrades.

What to expect of your role:

We are looking for a Customer Support Agent for a fully remote role, acting as the main point of contact for customers and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues.

You will be expected to:

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers actively using the product;
  • Respond to customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner;
  • Provide customer support via email and chat;
  • Gain a good understanding of the product to effectively answer customer questions;
  • Communicate with other team members to find solutions when needed;
  • Escalate inquiries to the relevant departments when required.

(Full training will be provided.)

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Fluent Polish speaker;
  • Good communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset;
  • Active listening skills, patience, and attention to detail;
  • Ability to manage time effectively in a shift-based environment;
  • Affinity with technology;
  • Previous Customer Support experience is required;
  • Previous iGaming experience is a plus;
  • English level: B2 for internal communication.

Work Model & Schedule:

  • Fully remote role;
  • Shift-based position;
  • Day shifts only (no night shifts);
  • Working days: 4 days on / 2 days off;
  • Shifts may include weekends.

About our corporate culture:

As an international team, we are motivated by the freedom to do our best work. Our employees are autonomous and responsible for their projects, taking the initiative when necessary, not giving up on their opinions, and speaking freely. We invest in the potential of each person, confident that together, our skills will shape the company’s future success.

Reasons to join us:

  • Our positive workplace atmosphere creates a culture of collaboration and support, making it a place you'll love working in;
  • We offer competitive compensation and regular career development reviews to motivate you to reach your full potential and love the work you do;
  • We offer a generous vacation and sick leave policy, allowing you to take time off and enjoy a work-life balance;
  • You'll love working here because we provide financial assistance for professional development, helping you stay ahead of the curve and love your career path;
  • Our Educational Allowances give you the opportunity to expand your knowledge and experience, not only in your work but also in other areas;
  • You'll love the monthly allowance for personal activities, giving you the opportunity to pursue your interests and hobbies outside of work;
  • At our company, we prioritise the health and well-being of our employees, which is why we offer comprehensive health insurance plans;
  • Our referral program rewards you for bringing top talent to the company, making it a place you enjoy sharing with others;
  • With engaging team-building activities and corporate parties, you'll love being part of our community and team spirit.

Ready to join us? Apply for this position!

What’s next?

Our recruiters will review your CV and reach out to you if you are suitable for the role.

What your process will look like:

  1. HR Interview with the Recruiter;
  2. Final interview with the team;
  3. Final decision.

Our recruitment team is very willing to help out, so contact us with any questions you may have!

raw.description:
Project Overview

We are sourcing independent Language Alignment & Resource Partners (LARPs) to provide native-level Arabic language vetting and QA for a specialized AI data project. As AI systems strive to reflect real-world usage and deliver human-like communication, their accuracy depends entirely on rigorous linguistic and cultural consultation. The objective of this project is to evaluate, annotate, and validate data to ensure high-quality outputs that are fully natural, polished, and free from bias.

Project Deliverables & Scope

Operate autonomously to provide linguistic QA and develop alignment resources. Expected deliverables include:

  • Data Annotation & Review: Reviewing, annotating, and testing AI outputs for grammatical accuracy, naturalness, and strict cultural context.
  • Quality Assurance & Vetting: Acting as a primary quality check during production to proactively identify and correct subtle cultural errors or awkward phrasing in the Arabic language.
  • Resource Generation: Analyzing task quality trends and autonomously developing educational resources and feedback documentation to increase alignment between AI task outputs and campaign expectations.
  • Production & Vetting Support: Providing native-level language vetting during project scaling and offering specialized linguistic consultation throughout the production phase.

Required Expertise

To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess a meticulous eye for language and cultural nuance.

Core skillset includes:

  • Demonstrable work or educational experience in linguistics, education, or other fields requiring high attention to linguistic detail.
  • Prior, tangible experience working in human data evaluation or annotation.
  • Verified Arabic language proficiency of C1 or C2
  • The ability to confidently transform raw feedback and quality trends into structured, actionable educational resources.
  • A meticulous approach to language, with the sharpness to identify and correct even the most subtle unnatural phrasing in their native tongue.

Service Fees

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Workplace Type: Remote

About Brighty App

The Role

You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Finance teams to uncover trends, monitor KPIs, and optimize user experience in our fast-evolving fintech and digital asset ecosystem.

  • Understanding of statistical methods, A/B testing, and data modeling
  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and strong communication skills
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken)

Why Join Us?

  • Freedom to Innovate: Shape how data drives business decisions
  • Flexible Work: Remote or hybrid setup
  • 30 Vacation Days: Because rest matters
  • Cool Team: Supportive and fun culture (pets included 🐾)

We’re Valatam, a team that connects bilingual professionals from Latin America with global clients. Our people are our pride, and we’re thrilled to be certified as a Great Place to Work for the 2025-2026 period, proof that great work starts with great people.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Junior Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional bilingual support to our clients and their customers. This is an entry-level, 100% remote, full-time position for candidates in Latin America. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for routine inquiries, learning our client's processes, building your skills, and providing a top-tier customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist customers with basic inquiries, including account updates, general questions, and standard troubleshooting.

Our Core Values at Work

We live by ACTION (get things done), CARE (help others and do things right), OUTSTANDING (operate at the highest standards), DEPENDABLE (own every commitment), and ENERGY (bring positivity every day). You’ll thrive here if these values resonate with you.

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Philadelphia, PA

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.
